page_title: AnnexEdit – Markdown Editor for Mac and macOS

summary.name: AnnexEdit
summary.one_liner: AnnexEdit is a native Markdown editor for macOS (macOS 14+) with eight themes, a vault tree, templates, and PDF/DOCX/HTML/Markdown export, sold as a one-time purchase.
use_cases: writing notes and articles in Markdown on a Mac
exporting Markdown documents to PDF or DOCX
organizing Markdown files in a vault folder
using templates for screenplays or recipes
importing DOCX or XLSX into Markdown
summary.what_it_does: AnnexEdit is a macOS Markdown editor with eight visual themes (Neutral, Terminal, Book, Coder, Diary, Storybook, Amigo, C3P64) and 33 keyboard shortcuts. It exports to Markdown, HTML, PDF and DOCX, and supports drag-and-drop import of DOCX and XLSX into Markdown. Files are stored in a local folder and the app runs offline; the page says it has no tracking and no telemetry. The Pro tier adds a vault tree, custom templates, AI autocomplete, a JSON editor with linter, and a bidirectional workspace mirror with Promptopoly.
notable: Eight themes including Terminal, Book and C3P64 styles
Local folder storage, works offline, cloud sync not included
Basic and Pro one-time purchase tiers, with 1.x updates free
Optional Promptopoly mirror and free remote templates after linking a free Promptopoly account
caveats: Pro features such as custom templates, AI autocomplete and workspace mirror are only in the paid Pro tier; premium templates are locked
Basic price from €9 one-time; the page lists VAT-inclusive prices (Basic €1.44 VAT, Pro €3.03 VAT) and it is a paid product
